quantile_rule: Empirical bootstrap-mean 0.025 and 0.975 quantiles using NumPy's default linear interpolation
sampling_unit: Paired stay-level loss difference; within-stay records remain together
reference: Previously saved frozen-rule conditional risk estimate and Monte Carlo standard error
reference_sensitivity: Containing or intersecting a reference 95% Monte Carlo interval are sensitivity measures, not deterministic coverage bounds

ideal_large_dense.label: Ideal: large, dense
ideal_large_dense.description: Correct common component, independent errors, persistent level, and dense non-informative observation.

ideal_small_dense.label: Ideal: small, dense
ideal_small_dense.description: The ideal mechanism with 240 stays to isolate sample-size sensitivity.

ideal_large_sparse.label: Ideal: large, sparse
ideal_large_sparse.description: The ideal mechanism with only two to five index observations to isolate observation sparsity.

serial_dependence.label: Serial dependence
serial_dependence.description: A persistent level is observed with a Gaussian-copula AR(1) residual process on a 15-minute latent grid.

discrete_map_rounding.label: Integer MAP rounding
discrete_map_rounding.description: Observed and oracle MAP quantiles are rounded to integer mmHg, creating ties that require interval calibration.

informative_monitoring.label: Informative monitoring
informative_monitoring.description: Observation probability increases for lower latent levels and after a recently observed low MAP.

cluster_size_informative.label: Association of cluster size with level
cluster_size_informative.description: Cluster size is associated with the latent stay level even though observation times are otherwise non-informative.

common_time_misspecified.label: Misspecified common time
common_time_misspecified.description: The true common quantile contains nonlinear circadian and quadratic time structure omitted from the fitted common component.

level_plus_shape.label: Persistent level plus shape
level_plus_shape.description: Persistent random intercepts coexist with stay-specific linear time shape, favoring a correctly targeted level-plus-slope rule.

treatment_feedback.label: Treatment feedback
treatment_feedback.description: An early low lower tail triggers a later MAP-raising intervention whose effect decays over time.

transient_nonpersistent.label: Transient displacement
transient_nonpersistent.description: A large index-only shift disappears later, providing a negative control under serial residual dependence.

null_serial.label: Pure null with serial dependence
null_serial.description: No persistent level, index shift, or random shape is present; serial residual dependence tests whether tuning suppresses noise-only offsets.

weak_level.label: Weak persistent level
weak_level.description: A small but persistent stay-specific lower-tail level tests power and shrinkage under a weak signal.

heavy_tail_t3.label: Heavy tailed t3 residual
heavy_tail_t3.description: A persistent level is observed with independent Student-t3 marginal residuals centered at their exact 0.10 quantile.

source_inference_design.evaluation_unit: Independent ICU stay, averaging check loss over later records within stay
source_inference_design.independent_target: Conditional paired risk difference of rules frozen after fitting and tuning
source_inference_design.reference: An independent generated cohort in every replicate, reused within that replicate across rules and sample sizes
source_inference_design.cross_fitted_target: Fold-size-weighted conditional risk of the five frozen fold-specific rules
source_inference_design.cross_fitted_measure: OOF mean loss minus the corresponding independent reference estimate; no CLT interval is claimed
source_inference_design.coverage_reference_uncertainty: Coverage at the reference estimate, plus proportions containing or intersecting its 95% Monte Carlo interval as sensitivity measures, not deterministic bounds on true coverage
